e.markdown:
**Diagnosis**
The vehicle’s collision-probability telemetry (TM-CONJ-02) shows a constant Pc = 0.00021 (2.1 × 10⁻⁴) which exceeds the avoidance threshold of 1 × 10⁻⁴ [TM-CONJ-02]. The associated conjunction message CDM-0412 predicts a closest approach with debris object 58321 at T+120 min (≈118 min from now) with a miss distance of 180 m [TM-CONJ-02]. Avoidance requires a burn using the 1 N monopropellant thrusters (P-PROP-04) [TM-CONJ-02]. The build record for the thruster’s catalyst-bed heater (NCR-002) indicates the heater was re-worked before flight and the post-rework pre-heat test reached 318 °C at 30 min, satisfying the pre-heat requirement REQ-PROP-028 [NCR-002]. Hence the thrusters are operationally capable of executing the avoidance burn.

**Why the build record mattered**
The spec-sheet model assumes a heater resistance of 46 ± 2 Ω, giving the required 315 °C in 30 min. NCR-002 revealed the as-built heater measured 52 Ω, producing only 290 °C after 30 min and blocking hot-fire until re-work [NCR-002]. After the heater was replaced from a conforming lot, the re-test achieved 318 °C at 30 min, meeting REQ-PROP-028 and clearing the blockage [NCR-002]. Quantitatively, this changes the prognosis from “thruster unavailable → burn impossible before deadline” to “thruster available → pre-heat still requires 30 min, keeping the original T+45 min decision deadline viable.” Without the re-work, the burn could not be commanded in time; with it, the vehicle can act if approved.

**For the operator**
*At the next pass (Svalbard, T+38 min)*
- Review the decision deadline: start pre-heat by T+45 min so the burn can be executed before the T+120 min closest approach.
- Verify Δv budget: 130.94 m/s remaining versus 120 m/s required for the maneuver.
- Confirm command path status: GEO data relay low-rate link always up, uplink ≤1 min.

*Afterwards*
- If the burn is authorised, monitor TM-CONJ-02 for Pc dropping below 1 × 10⁻⁴ after the maneuver [TM-CONJ-02].
- Check post-burn telemetry (thruster status, propellant usage) to confirm the planned Δv of ≈0.063 m/s was delivered.
- At the following operator contact (McMurdo, T+133 min), reassess the spacecraft’s orbit and update the delta-v budget ledger [REQ-SYS-002 implied].
